firm_data.firm_description: Weiss, Wexler & Wornow, P.C., is a New York City based law firm which provides legal expertise and counseling on an extensive array of workers’ compensation matters. Our firm enjoys a reputation for excellence, independence and integrity within the community of workers’ compensation professionals.

email.subject: AI for Weiss, Wexler and Wornow PC, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Darryl,

Weiss, Wexler & Wornow has built a reputation for excellence in workers' compensation matters across New York. That specialization and client trust are exactly what we protect when helping firms compete with BigLaw without BigLaw resources.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of specialized practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
